fixes.issue: SSH negotiation fails against SHA-1-only servers
fixes.resolution: Opt-in legacySSH appends group14-sha1, group-exchange-sha1 and group1-sha1 to the default list for this host's SSH, SFTP and tunnels. Modern algorithms remain preferred.

fixes.issue: Electron/BoringSSL cannot resolve the named modp2 group
fixes.resolution: Version-checked, idempotent ssh2 1.17.0 patch constructs the identical RFC 2409 section 6.2 prime explicitly, without modifying global crypto APIs or enabling group1 by default.

fixes.issue: User wants to suppress first-contact fingerprint dialogs
fixes.resolution: Settings -> credentials -> confirmNewHostKeys can be disabled. First keys are automatically registered; changed keys remain blocked. Default is still confirmation.

fixes.issue: Keychain prompts during saved credential access
fixes.resolution: Added login keychain password guidance. Existing ad-hoc builds have different cdhash-based designated requirements, so updates can re-prompt. Keychain entries were not read, deleted or modified.
Bootstrap carries app.getVersion() for the status bar and settings.

electronGUI.scope: Full GUI before the final version-display-only change. Six usability scenarios passed after that change; the final packaged legacy GUI test covers the displayed version and new SSH/host-key behavior.

dockerSSH.scope: Alpine, Ubuntu, Debian, Rocky, CentOS Stream 9, CentOS 7, and two CentOS 7/OpenSSH 7.4 instances restricted to group1-sha1 or GEX-sha1 with ssh-rsa/aes128-ctr/hmac-sha1.

checks: no first-key dialog with confirmation disabled

limitations: The user-specified CentOS 5.11 SSH endpoint timed out during a no-authentication handshake probe; its actual algorithm offer and authenticated connection could not be verified.
Legacy algorithm interoperability was verified with real OpenSSH 7.4 on CentOS 7, not actual CentOS 5/6 operating systems.
Native Keychain approval and permission persistence require user interaction; GUI fixtures do not access the user's keychain.
The previous 0.3.1 ten-minute stress and 4 GiB transfer results were not repeated for 0.3.2.
Windows and macOS 14 execution remain unverified.
